The services Kel can use. You keep the credential — it is stored encrypted on this computer, and Kel only ever records that it exists.

Services
none yet
Add a service
GitHub
API key · https://api.github.com
Kel needs a personal access token with the scopes you want Kel to have.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up GitHub
Stripe
API key · https://api.stripe.com
Kel needs a secret key from your Stripe account.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up Stripe
Figma
API key · https://api.figma.com
Kel needs a personal access token from your Figma settings.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up Figma
ClickUp
API key · https://api.clickup.com/api/v2
Kel needs your personal ClickUp API token.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up ClickUp
Discord
Bot or webhook · https://discord.com/api/v10
Kel needs the bot token for the Discord bot you want Kel to use.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up Discord
Google Drive
Account authorization · https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3
Kel needs account authorization — you sign in and Kel keeps the token.
Kel knows this address from the service’s own documentation.
Set up Google Drive
Pitcher List
API key · https://pitcherlist.com/wp-json
Kel needs the WordPress application password from your Pitcher List account, with your username.
Kel assumes the usual address — correct it if this service gave you a different one.
Set up Pitcher List
Raptive
API key · address comes with your credential
Kel needs the API credential from your Raptive account.
Kel does not know this address; the service tells you when it issues your credential.
Set up Raptive
